notes.title: Girls Introduction #12 - Eva
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645989/c6b09528fbc7e843d89d72c2055b18335086e8f2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Meet Eva![/b] This kitty with an incredible figure plays the role of a refined and noble lady in public, but in private conversations she reveals a completely different side of herself and allows far more than you’d expect.[/p]

notes.title: Girls Introduction #11 - Skye
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645989/a2ad92725551716df57f713dc2608b15eb9ae19d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Today we have another beauty! Her name is [b]Skye[/b]. She’s cheerful, playful, and sporty.[/p]

notes.title: Girls Introduction #10 - Cassandra
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645989/2d81b0acb8ad1f4118db44a03b38fb33c37f9a0f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Meet Cassie![/b][/p][p]Unusual, funny, and dreamy. At first glance, she seems quiet and rarely talks to people, but inside she has a vast world that she only reveals to a select few. If you like quirky and playful girls, you’ll definitely enjoy her. She’ll bring a touch of cyberpunk atmosphere into the game.[/p]

notes.title: Girls Introduction #8 - Jade
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645989/55b5531441157d4e2d1842b9d13499c95c20b118.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hi everyone! Today I want to introduce you to [b]Jade[/b]. She’s like a true Ice Queen — smart, cold, strict… and, just like in the fairy tale, only true love can melt her heart.[/p][p]Right now, I’m actively preparing a New Year’s surprise. I’m working on characters, writing the script, and rendering scenes. I know the story is still a mystery to you, but it’s important for me to learn about [b]your expectations[/b]. What matters most to you in a visual novel? What would you pay attention to first? This will help me understand where to focus my efforts the most.[/p][p]I’m closely studying player feedback from other projects, but my main challenge right now is figuring out exactly what you expect from my game.[/p]

notes.title: Girls Introduction #7 - Tanya
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645989/48d39cd41d7bdc2e8304294c2077b2862fe9f709.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hi![b] [/b]I’m back again with a new heroine!

[b]Her name is Tanya[/b], and she might just become the embodiment of your darkest fantasies. You might even scare yourself with your own desires — but don’t worry, only you and she will ever know. Tanya is a talented second-year student who lives under constant pressure from her own ambitions. The more stressed she gets, the deeper and darker her passion becomes. Don’t fight it — just relax and let her take full control.

[b]Care to share your darkest desires… if you dare?[/b][/p]

notes.title: Girls Introduction #6 - Sohyun
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645989/4ce858d11c007ae98262f2d64ea61eadd7bcfa32.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Meet Sohyun![/b][/p][p]A first-year student with big ambitions and a bold personality, she brings a fresh, energetic K-pop vibe to the story of my visual novel. She’s not just driven and artistic — she’s a true perfectionist, ready to go all the way to make her dreams come true, both on stage and in life.[/p][p][b]K-pop fans, be honest — have you ever wanted to try building a relationship with an idol?[/b]
[b]What do you think of this kind of character?

[/b]What I especially love about developing characters is fully immersing myself in their world. When creating their appearance, backstory, and scenes, I try to deeply study and feel the field they belong to. If it’s K-pop, I constantly listen to my favorite tracks, explore how the industry works, and dive into its culture. If it’s fashion, I watch documentaries and films about the fashion world, study its history, and keep up with the latest runway shows. There’s a huge amount of research behind every character to make their world feel as real and believable as possible.[/p][p]It’s a meticulous process, but I absolutely love it. In my visual novel, I explore many areas of art and culture, and I sincerely want to share with you the most fascinating things I’ve found and brought to life.[/p]

notes.title: Girls Introduction #5 - Camille
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645989/2c456586a51e3ff8662f47b8f3a0171c2a1cf77c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Bonjour, mes chéris ![/b]

[b]Meet Camille![/b] And yes — another redhead among the main heroines. But I swear it’s not on purpose! I’m just showing the girls who are already ready for the story. I promise the next one definitely won’t be a redhead!

Camille is a charming French girl with a gentle and romantic nature, but behind her elegant appearance hides a strong will and the ability to stand her ground.

[b]Her appearance was really difficult to create — I wanted her to truly look like a real French girl.[/b]
[b]What do you think, did I manage to pull it off?
[/b]
By the way, about the name of the game: I’ve seen that not everyone likes it. The name wasn’t chosen randomly, and even though there might be better options, changing it now would be difficult and time-consuming. I’d rather spend that time on the game itself — to make it the way I envision it, and the way you’re hoping it will be. Let this be a small imperfection in my first game.

Your comments and feedback really help me understand what’s truly important to you. I can see the strong interest in the project by the number of wishlists, and that motivates me to pay even more attention to every detail. It’s a bit exciting, of course, but it also feels good to carry that kind of responsibility.

Once again, thank you so much for your support and for believing in my game!

[b]À la semaine prochaine ![/b][/p]

notes.title: Girls Introduction #4 - Kelly
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645989/89a8d4846e4fb49a69fad6642af028b170610c70.jpg"][/img][/p][p]What's better than one gorgeous redhead among the main girls? Two gorgeous redheads who also happen to be close friends! [b]Meet Kelly![/b] She's outgoing, emotional, carefree, and absolutely loves being the center of attention.

[b]I'm genuinely curious—who would you pick? Mira, Kelly, or perhaps both?
[/b][/p][p]Mira's post generated incredible enthusiasm, and I'm truly inspired by how much you enjoyed her character. [b]I'm still refining future girls and would love your input—what kind of girl would you like to see more of? Sexy and confident, sweet and romantic, dominant and kinky, or maybe playful and cheerful?[/b][/p]

notes.title: Girls Introduction #3 - Karina
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645989/29dafda80b304142b37a5bfd5e214fa4a6c4394d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Meet Karina![/b] She's bold, combative, and incredibly stubborn — definitely not someone who plays by the rules. Karina lives for adrenaline, and her energy makes every moment around her feel intense and unpredictable.[/p][p][b]Her story is filled with wild twists, and trust me—there'll never be a dull moment with her. Do you think you could handle a relationship with someone as fierce and rebellious as Karina?[/b][/p]

notes.title: Girls Introduction #2 - Mira
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645989/b51fac35ef51cc96358fce64fa42aa54010145ed.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Meet Mira! This fiery redhead is a second-year student, a talented artist, and pure walking sunshine.[/b]
She’s always ready to brighten your day with a smile and spark something wild and creative in you! But the details of her story — you’ll have to discover those in the game itself.[/p][p][b]What do you think of her style? What’s your first impression of her?[/b][/p][p]I’m pouring my heart into creating my first game — I even quit my job to dedicate all my time to it. Your support means the world to me and gives me the energy to push forward and bring my boldest ideas to life.[/p]

notes.title: Girls Introduction #1 - Evelyn
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645989/7332ed477476cc660dc3f9bd46cf58d4a037a714.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I invited the girls from my visual novel for a photo session to introduce each of them to you one by one. And here comes the first![/p][p]This is [b]Evelyn[/b] – a second-year student majoring in art history. She's known for throwing wild themed parties… and she runs a secret club. But if you're planning to get in, be ready to face your darkest desires.[/p][p][/p][p]Each girl crafted with care so that their looks and clothing match their personality. I’ve spent a lot of time shaping each of them, and I’d really love to hear your honest opinion:[/p][p][/p][p][b]What do you think of Evelyn?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]More girls coming soon in this render series – stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Continuum - Season 1: Coming to Steam Early Access!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=mTzp7pbdWfE;full][/previewyoutube]

Hi everyone! I'm Lacosta from Hot Forge Games, and I'm super excited to finally show you something I've been working on for the last two years!

It's a visual novel set in an elite arts academy, full of unique characters and engaging stories. You'll dive into a world where art isn't just about paintings or sculptures — it's about building relationships, exploring emotions, and appreciating the beauty around you, especially when it comes to captivating heroines. Each choice you make shapes your own personal journey.

The game is actively in development, and there's still lots of work to do until at least the end of 2025. I'd be really happy if you'd join me along the way and help make something genuinely special.

I'll start introducing you soon to each of the 25 amazing girls you'll meet in the game — stay tuned! Add the game to your wishlist and stay up to date with all the upcoming news and events!
